leadText: Yudai Chiba (Japanese: 千葉雄大 Chiba Yūdai) is a Japanese voice actor .
plainText:
Yudai Chiba (Japanese: 千葉雄大 Chiba Yūdai) is a Japanese voice actor . 

==Biography==
Chiba was born on March 9, 1989 in . and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the during , where his only role was Ilima, a recurring character. Chiba is currently affiliated with Japan Music Entertainment.

==Pokémon roles==

Ilima
